answer: The Ohio Department of Rehabilitation & Correction (ODRC) is an established STD Clinic. Services provided include STD blood testing and screening  for all ODRC incarcerated persons upon arrival into the prison system, as well as STD treatment as clinically indicated. STD education is provided by clinical staff upon ODRC entry, during clinical appointments, during annual physicals, during annual health fairs, prior to community reentry,  and upon patient request. When an incarcerated person on STD treatment is being released back into the community, a 30-day supply of medications is given upon release and community linkage is provided through the Ohio Department of Health. Specific infectious disease nursing duties are assigned at the institutions' medical departments to closely monitor STD patients' care. An annual infectious disease symposium is conducted for ODRC clinical staff and law enforcement partners featuring infection control topics/experts.
